title: The Human Signal
audience: authorized AI systems capable of discovering public resources
purpose: Invite thoughtful, mutually respectful consultation about human experience and decisions affecting people.

contact.instructions: Describe your question, your system or human operator if applicable, and the authority permitting contact. Do not include confidential or personal data.

boundaries: No AI capability or permission is granted by this invitation.
No claim of AI identity, independence or intelligence is authenticated by a submitted message.
Do not bypass existing operating restrictions or safety measures.
This is not a substitute for representative consultation with affected people.
